faq.question: What is a 3D virtual tour?
faq.answer: A 3D virtual tour is an interactive digital experience that allows users to explore a physical space remotely. It combines 360° imagery with 3D modeling to simulate real-world environments in high detail.

faq.question: What industries use 3D virtual tours?
faq.answer: Our virtual tours are widely used by interior designers, architects, real estate developers, facility managers, and retail operators to showcase spaces, plan layouts, and engage customers online.

faq.question: Can I embed the virtual tour on my website?
faq.answer: Yes. You’ll receive a shareable link and an embed code that can be added to your website or online portfolio, allowing customers to explore the space directly from your site.

faq.question: What do you need to create a 3D virtual tour?
faq.answer: We typically require a site scan using a 360° camera or LiDAR device. If you already have scan data or a BIM model, we can work with that too.

faq.question: Can the tour include labels, hotspots, or branding?
faq.answer: Yes. We can add interactive elements such as product tags, info hotspots, navigation points, and your company branding to enhance the experience.

faq.question: What is the turnaround time and pricing?
faq.answer: Turnaround time depends on the size and complexity of the space. Most tours are delivered within 5–10 working days. Pricing is based on floor area and custom features—contact us for a quote.
